name: Ziprasidone
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Most metabolic clearance is reductive, involving glutathione and aldehyde oxidase, rather than CYP oxidation. CYP3A4 contributes to the smaller oxidative component. Elimination is mainly fecal as metabolites.
